mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tb_follow (user_id, follow_user_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{followUserId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_follow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND follow_user_id = #{followUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.icon FROM tb_follow f1 JOIN tb_follow f2 ON f2.follow_user_id = f1.follow_user_id JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = f1.follow_user_id WHERE f1.user_id = #{userId} AND f2.user_id = #{targetUserId} ORDER BY f1.create_time DESC LIMIT 20
